meals.note: Meal 1 only if Sirocco is short of Support 3; Ultand is out this chapter.

missables.text: Pick up the [[item:Star Spear]] in Zenzele's Paradise before you start the battle
missables.lose: The Star Spear, Cai's Caladrius spear

missables.text: Hand in 8 Insect Pearls for Even More Fabled Insect Pearls, the last step of the chain
Recruit Nezha this chapter: from Ch 10 he joins past Lv 20 without the Salamander

note.text: No exams: Advanced needs Renown 8, usually Ch 10. Spend the Arena weeks on the exam ranks
detail: Arena order: Guzran Sword B, Seteth Flying C, Axe B, Spear B, Ninae Spear B, then Ultand and Cai Black Magic B.
Expect Cai, Tialla, Guzran near Lv 35 by Ch 10; Ultand a map behind; Seteth, Ninae about Lv 30 (35 in Ch 11).
Renown 8 at the very end of Ch 9? Start the Ch 10 list now; Cai's Caladrius needs Castor's request first.

note.text: Save gold for 6 to 7 Advanced Licenses from Megaira over Ch 10 to 12

recruits.action: Hand over 3× Sandworm Meat while he's under Lv 20: he brings a Salamander

prep.text: Leave Nuzzuo for Ch 10: recruited then, he brings a Levin Sword
Reached Renown 7 only now? Do Castor's request (Ch 8 row), the Theater and Headsman's Rock this week

explore.text: Skipped [[place:Cave Behind the Falls]] (Lv 22, Castalia) in Ch 8? Run it now for Tialla's Archive B

detail: Run it with your support pairs; it stays the support run through Ch 11.

tips.text: Fog of war: have Credna's blessing at Lv 1 ready
detail: Noctula: pack a Miranilla Juice (or a spare Vulnerary) for baiting in the fog.

tips.text: Enemies come from every side: hold your start, then push north together
Aurora fights with you: she has Heal, Recover, Fortify and Warp
Ultand is out in free time, so Noctula takes her slot and Cai (Shaman) is the caster
detail: Tialla and Ninae (both Priests) cover the healing.
